# pmon_table_detail (Data Source)

One table's live shape: columns with their current tags, plus the relationships and size pmon sees.

Use this over `pmon_catalog` when the decision is about one table. The foreign keys are worth reading before classifying: a column that is a key into a table holding PII usually deserves the same treatment as the column it points at.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pmon_table_detail" "users" {
  datasource = "example-prod-rw"
  schema     = "example"
  table      = "users"
}

# A key into a table holding PII usually deserves the same treatment as the column it points at.
output "keys_into_this_table" {
  value = [
    for fk in data.pmon_table_detail.users.referenced_by :
    "${fk.source_table}.${join(",", fk.source_columns)}"
  ]
}

# Column comments are often the best hint about what a column actually holds.
output "commented_columns" {
  value = {
    for c in data.pmon_table_detail.users.columns :
    c.name => c.comment if c.comment != ""
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datasource` (String) Datasource holding the table.
- `schema` (String) Schema holding the table.
- `table` (String) Table to describe.

### Read-Only

- `columns` (Attributes List) The table's columns, in ordinal order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--columns))
- `engine` (String) Storage engine, for example `InnoDB`.
- `estimated_rows` (Number) The engine's own row estimate. An estimate, not a count.
- `foreign_keys` (Attributes List) Keys this table holds into other tables. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--foreign_keys))
- `on_disk_bytes` (Number) Approximate size on disk.
- `referenced_by` (Attributes List) Keys other tables hold into this one. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--referenced_by))

<a id="nestedatt--columns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `columns`

Read-Only:

- `auto_increment` (Boolean) Whether the engine assigns the value.
- `comment` (String) Column comment. Often the best hint about what a column actually holds.
- `data_type` (String) Engine's own type name.
- `default_value` (String) Declared default, null when there is none.
- `name` (String) Column name.
- `nullable` (Boolean) Whether the column accepts null.
- `ordinal` (Number) Position of the column in the table, from 1.
- `part_of_index` (Boolean) Whether any index covers the column.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags already on the column. Empty when unclassified.


<a id="nestedatt--foreign_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `foreign_keys`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Constraint name.
- `source_columns` (List of String) Referencing columns.
- `source_schema` (String) Schema holding the referencing table.
- `source_table` (String) Referencing table.
- `target_columns` (List of String) Referenced columns.
- `target_schema` (String) Schema holding the referenced table.
- `target_table` (String) Referenced table.


<a id="nestedatt--referenced_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `referenced_by`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Constraint name.
- `source_columns` (List of String) Referencing columns.
- `source_schema` (String) Schema holding the referencing table.
- `source_table` (String) Referencing table.
- `target_columns` (List of String) Referenced columns.
- `target_schema` (String) Schema holding the referenced table.
- `target_table` (String) Referenced table.
